ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Based on the given food web, which organism is a carnivore?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: On the left side of the figure is the “Producers and Consumers” food web, including Barn Owl, Brown Snake, Gray Fox, Brush Mouse, Great Plains Toad, Eastern Cottontail, Rock Squirrel, Field Cricket, and plants, etc. Barn Owl is marked at the top of the left panel, and in the figure there are arrows from other animals pointing to it. On the right side is the decomposers panel, including Bacteria, Fungi, Worms. Reasoning: Arrows in a food web indicate food or energy flowing from the organism being eaten to the predator. A carnivore is an organism that eats other animals. Because Barn Owl receives arrows from animals, this indicates that it eats other animals, so it is a carnivore.
